explanation: Shrunk scenario is a single elastic (e=1) ball falling under gravity bouncing on floor. Between step 55 and 56 it bounces: vy goes from -12.36 to +14.20, speed increases ~15%, energy jumps from 83.86 to 108.99 exceeding E0+10%+5 bound. No controller work involved. This indicates floor collision with e=1 is injecting energy (likely restitution/positional correction adding energy or velocity reversal error) instead of conserving it. Changing e to 0.8 removes violation.
vision_note: Frames 53-56 show a single blue ball falling toward the bottom floor wall and making contact around step 55-56. No dramatic tunneling, exit, or position jump is visible in this short strip; the ball simply appears to touch the floor as expected for a bounce.
